infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Halal Mode uses your photo library so you can add clear, recent photos to your profile.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Halal Mode uses your camera so you can take a clear, recent profile photo.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Halal Mode uses your microphone to record your voice introduction and voice notes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Halal Mode uses your location while you set up your profile to privately apply your chosen distance preference. Your exact location is never shown to other members.
